issues.proposed_body:
The existing Digit Lab implementation predates this Issue. This is retrospective
submission work, not evidence of pre-implementation approval or an instruction to
retrain. Scope: reconcile the selected captcha-v3 model with its source reports,
participant-approved specification and a complete submission index.

Dependencies: none for evidence discovery. The participant instructed preservation
of the current dia2-local website after the context proposal was presented;
record that limited retrospective scope. Instructor acceptance is separate.

Acceptance:

- Link configuration, seeds, split, environment, training history, selection,
  clean/synthetic metrics, confusion/errors, preprocessing and weight hash.
- Verify ignored local weights against recorded manifest SHA-256 without changing
  weights, original reports or official challenge inputs.
- Link present participant approval accurately as retrospective; identify absent
  original approvals and remaining instructor decisions.

Verification: check every local evidence link/hash, review scope and chronology,
record commands/results and final commit. Do not use historical test counts as
fresh test execution. Course exercise source remains unchanged.

<!-- submission-followup-status -->
## Submission follow-up — 2026-10-17

Evidence index, source reviews and explicit lifecycle coverage are delivered. The participant confirmed continuing the existing approach while preserving dia2-local. That bounded present review is recorded separately from the original design-approval/process gap and instructor assessment; no retrospective approval is invented.

The existing exported weights/checkpoints are ignored and are not supplied by a
source clone. This Issue completes the submission artifact process, not training.

Depends on the evidence-index Issue in this batch (`evidence` in issue-plan.json).

Acceptance:

- Document an authorized artifact retrieval or reproducible training route with
  model identity, byte count, SHA-256 and restoration paths.
- Demonstrate restoration in an isolated clean directory/environment; preserve
  existing checkpoints, exports and frozen evaluation outputs.
- Keep secrets, datasets and weights outside Git; document font/runtime limits if
  using the historical training route.

Verification: record retrieval/restoration commands and manifest hash comparisons.
Do not overwrite historical outputs or claim a clone alone includes weights.

## Submission follow-up — 2026-10-17

Browser-weight recovery passed in an isolated environment. A fresh dependency install, copied IDX/split/source/baseline checks and 44 local font identities passed. Full retraining was not run; portable public checkpoint/font availability remains unestablished, so this broader artifact Issue remains open.

Verify the existing selected captcha-v3 CNN and application for submission.
Earlier test reports are retrospective context, not a current suite result.

Depends on verified artifacts (`artifacts` in issue-plan.json).

Acceptance:

- Run the relevant existing Python unit suite and preserve actual output/count.
- Check Python/JavaScript preprocessing, logits and real activations within 0.0001.
- Exercise drawing, upload/batch upload, clear/reset, scores, activation displays,
  export, invalid input and weight-download failure recovery.
- Label mocked versus real-model checks and desktop versus physical-phone limits;
  confirm inference uses browser pixels and weights, not a remote inference API.

Verification: use new report names, record environment and model hash, link final
commits and findings. No retraining or new official challenge accuracy experiment.

The participant instructed preservation of the current dia2-local development and
website at https://naoquerosaber.pt/AI/. Keep it intact; no migration, replacement
or production change is authorized in this batch. GitHub Pages remains an unmet
course requirement unless the instructor accepts the existing host substitution.

Depends on artifact restoration and local verification (`artifacts`, `verification`
in issue-plan.json). Confirm repository permissions and deployment authorization
before external configuration/publication.

Acceptance:

- Obtain and link instructor acceptance of the existing hosting substitution.
  If the instructor instead requires Pages, propose a separate deployment using
  verified weights/static assets and obtain participant authorization before it.
- Verify submitted-origin asset hashes, mouse/touch drawing, uploads, reset,
  per-image scores, real activations and failure recovery.
- Record URL, release/commit, model identity, screenshots and limits. Keep the
  participant-trained CNN default; distinguish optional pretrained OCR readers.

Verification: fresh browser evidence at the submitted origin, static asset checks
and parity against the frozen model. Any official-image reuse is deployment
verification after exposure, never a new independent accuracy result.

Preserve and index existing frozen challenge evidence without tuning or rerunning
the official evaluation. Original recorded 99.28% MNIST / 2-of-10 and later follow-ups
retain separate model and runtime identities.

Depends on model evidence index (`evidence` in issue-plan.json).

Acceptance:

- Link frozen runtime/weights, ten raw predictions/scores, separate comparison,
  input hashes, error analysis and applicable public verification.
- Explain prior exposure and distinguish MNIST, synthetic and ten-image results.
- Preserve ignored raw artifacts through an appropriate artifact process rather
  than staging unrelated local files or completed test caches indiscriminately.

Verification: inspect existing hashes, sources and chronology only; no training,
model/preprocessing selection or score tuning using official images or answers.
Record absent artifacts and retrieval requirements instead of inventing evidence.

training and deployments precede this retrospective planning batch. New Issues
cannot prove earlier approval.

Dependencies: none to prepare the request; recipient/channel and a real instructor
response are external dependencies. Do not fabricate feedback or contact details.

Acceptance:

- Send the prepared process-deviation request to an identified instructor through
  an authorized channel with links to actual submission evidence.
- Ask about assistant substitution, personal fork/starter layout, retrospective
  planning and hosting substitution if needed.
- Record date, reviewer, response, conditions and unresolved corrective actions.

Verification: preserve actual delivery/response evidence without credentials or
private messages in public artifacts. A drafted request or public Issue is not
instructor acceptance. Mark pending until the external response exists.
